history.summary: A near-completion (2027 TOP) 1270sqft 4BR new launch in The Botany at Dairy Farm, D23 (Hillview/Bukit Panjang), at $2.3M / $1811 psf — about 15% below the $2124 district median, near Hillview MRT (DTL, 800m) in a greenery-led nature precinct. No resale history yet (new launch), but the entry PSF and nature/DTL positioning are attractive.
history.rating_rationale: $1811 psf is ~15% below the $2124 district median — a meaningful discount, and 1270sqft is a sensibly-sized (not oversized) 4BR at a $2.3M family quantum. Hillview DTL (800m) gives direct downtown access, and Dairy Farm's nature-reserve setting is a durable own-stay/family-resale draw. Caveats: it is a not-yet-completed new launch (no resale data — null URA rate; pricing carries developer bias), TOP 2027 pushes the SSD-safe hold out, and 4BR narrows the pool. But the clear PSF discount and DTL/nature positioning support a Buy at the family-target altitude.
red_flags: New launch, 2027 TOP — no resale track record, appreciation unproven, developer pricing bias
4BR at $2.3M — family-only buyer pool, above deepest-liquidity band
D23 OCR (Bukit Panjang/Hillview) — solid but not a top-tier appreciation district
catalysts: ~15% below district median PSF — genuine value entry for a new launch
